summary: Two queue-factory comments omit enforced capacity preconditions; one Boolean zero-value comment misstates the contract.

items.issue: The documentation does not say that `capacity` must be positive and non-null. It is passed directly to `LinkedBlockingQueue`, which rejects a non-positive capacity and cannot accept `null`.
items.suggestion: State the positive, non-null requirement on `capacity` and document the resulting exceptions if retaining exception details elsewhere in this API.

items.issue: `Prop` requires a zero value of type `T`, but does not specifically require `false`; `false` is the appropriate Boolean zero value here.
items.suggestion: Say that this is the Boolean zero value, rather than that `false` is required by the `Prop` contract.
